summary: Stop and disable retained legacy monitors before node uninstall
details: usdb-node down stops both the current node monitor and a retained console monitor for the selected network. Controller disable removes autostart for both, without migrating or rewriting service definitions.
Uninstall still refuses active or enabled services, and now reports their observed state and a service-specific stop/disable command.
The handbook documents the r38 recovery command for upgrades that have not migrated the legacy observer.
operator_actions: On r38, if down and controller disable leave usdb-console-monitor active or enabled, stop and disable the named legacy service with sudo systemctl disable --now before retrying uninstall.
